newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CYCLING-WORLD CHAMPION MUSEEUW HAS KNEE SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-WORLD CHAMPION MUSEEUW HAS KNEE SURGERY.

text.p: World cycling champion Johan Museeuw of Belgium has had knee surgery and will be out of action for at least 10 days, a team spokesman said on Wednesday.

"The knee has become infected and surgery was needed to prevent blood poisoning," Jos Roofthooft, spokesman for the Italian-Belgian Mapei-GB outfit, told Reuters. "He can only start thinking of practising again in 10 days."
The knee became infected after Museeuw suffered a cut in a fall during a mountainbike ride on December 21.
